charaepi_ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2301_1101_:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] spotted Lysandre
in the mountains at dawn.
charaepi_ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2301_1201_: It’s you.

When I see that carefree smile of yours,
this cloud over me seems to clear slightly.
Look at this view.
Breathtaking, isn’t it?

This beautiful landscape, stretching out
before our eyes... It’s like no other.

Yet there are people who would try to take
these resources and land—things that don’t
belong to anyone.

Whether it’s the wealthy or the powers
that be...

they try to monopolize parts of the world,
as if entitled to them.
This world is teeming with greed.
When I think about it, I can’t help but sigh.

Legends surrounding Chi-Yu say it was born
from humanity’s limitless negative emotions.

It’s said that the envy accumulated within
curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts
clad itself in fire and became a Pokémon.

Which means envy can eventually lead to
ugly conflict.

Once a person develops a desire, it becomes
nearly impossible to eliminate.

Their flame of greed will burn until they get
what they want.

Perhaps it’s a curse that has befallen
humanity.
charaepi_ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2301_0401_: You certainly aren’t pulling any punches.
charaepi_ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2301_0302_:
What about wanting to change the
world?
charaepi_ch0196_11_fleurdelis/2301_1201_: Yes... You’re absolutely right.

I myself am driven by my desire to create
a beautiful world.

In the end, I suppose I am just as human as
those I despise.
I don’t know how you see me...

But I can’t help but hope for a future free
from conflict.

The fire of my convictions and hope for a
beautiful world shall not be extinguished!

If some fool were to try to claim Chi-Yu’s
power...

I would become a force of ruin myself—to
deliver justice.
